title: Points Held Back from Redemption: Returned Payments and Enrollment Bonus — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders points redemption, the redeemable points follow the account's payment record and age.

| Account's record | Redeemable points |
|---|---|
| A returned payment was posted on the account within the last twelve whole months and the account is below Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 1000 points stay held: the points balance less 1000, never below zero |
| No returned payment was posted within the last twelve whole months and the account was opened fewer than 12 whole months before the redemption date | enrollment bonus points (points credited without a repair order) stay held: the points balance less those bonus points, never below zero |
| Otherwise | the whole points balance |

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the redemption date, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on the redemption date count.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Silver account, a check returned five months ago, 2650 points on file: 1650 redeemable.
- Platinum account with the same returned check: the first row does not apply; the account was opened years ago, so the whole 2650 is redeemable.
- Silver account opened seven months ago, no returned payment, 900 points on file of which 250 were credited without a repair order: 650 redeemable.
